"""Escape text so it can go into HTML element content and attribute values."""

from __future__ import annotations

import html

ENTITIES = [("&", "&"), ("<", "<"), (">", ">"), ('"', """), ("'", "'")]


class Markup(str):
    """Text that is already safe HTML; escape() returns it unchanged."""


def escape(value: object) -> str:
    """Escape a value for HTML; Markup passes through unchanged."""
    if isinstance(value, Markup):
        return value
    text = str(value)
    for char, entity in ENTITIES:
        text = text.replace(char, entity)
    return text
